relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine, a selective NaV1.8 sodium channel inhibitor, represents a novel analgesic approach targeting peripheral nociceptive signaling.

key_findings: In a three-patient series, two of three sickle cell patients on minimal opioids reported improved pain with suzetrigine.
The patient on chronic opioid therapy did not improve, suggesting limited efficacy in opioid-tolerant individuals.
